name: Saltwall After Dark: Season One
description: A serialized crime drama set in the Gray Zone's most notoriously lawless district, placing viewers directly inside the body of Maren, a Tier 1 debt-runner navigating gang territories, corrupt municipal enforcers, and the slow collapse of her crew. Each episode ends with a mandatory 'debrief' overlay — a Vantablack licensing condition that briefly breaks immersion to remind viewers this is fiction. The debrief is widely despised and has become a cultural shorthand for corporate intrusion.
cultural_impact: Introduced the phrase 'hit the debrief' into Meridian slang, meaning an unwanted interruption that reminds you reality is worse than the story.
story_hooks: A player character receives a dead drop containing Season 3, Episode 6 — the one that was never officially aired.
The actress who played Maren has gone missing; her last known location was a the Gray Zone district identical to the show's setting.
A runner crew has begun modeling their operations on the show's tactics, and someone is feeding them real intelligence through the scripts.
